title: Flongle DirectRNA Library Preparation
author: Maximilian Krause
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bcwcixaw
materials: Add the following reagents and carefully mix by pipetting: 0.5 µL Nanopore RT adapter (RTA) 3 µL of NEBNext Quick Ligation buffer 1.5 µL T4 DNA Ligase ( 2000 U/ul, same as Quick T4 Ligase )

In a thermocycler, incubate at 50 °C for 00:50:00 , 70 °C for 00:10:00 and finally bring to 4 °C The incubation times can be reduced upon experience, as reverse transcription is optional and these incubation times are for most complete reverse transcription

Add the following reagents for Sequencing adapter ligation: 4 µL NEBNext Quick Ligation buffer 2 µL Nanopore RNA Adapter Mix (RMX) 2.5 µL RNase-free water 1.5 µL T4 DNA Ligase ( 2000 U/ul, same as Quick T4 Ligase )

steps.title: Prepare RNA sample
steps.instruction: Place 200 ng poly(A)-selected RNA in a 0.2 mL thin‑walled DNA‑free PCR tube, add RNase‑free water to a total volume of 9.5 µL (optionally add 0.5 µL RNA CS), and incubate 15 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Make reverse‑transcription master mix
steps.instruction: Combine 9 µL RNase‑free water, 2 µL 10 M dNTPs, 8 µL First‑Strand RT Buffer, and 4 µL 0.1 M DTT to create the RT master mix (optional).

steps.title: Add master mix and enzyme
steps.instruction: Add the RT master mix to the RNA sample, mix gently by pipetting, then add 2 µL SuperScript III RT enzyme and mix gently.

steps.title: Transfer to Lo‑Bind tube
steps.instruction: Transfer the entire reaction volume into a fresh 1.5 mL Lo‑Bind Safe‑Lock Eppendorf tube.

steps.title: Quantify final library
steps.instruction: Take 1 µL of the eluate and measure concentration with the Qubit DNA HS Kit (use the RNA HS Kit if cDNA synthesis was omitted); target recovery ≈ 80 ng.

steps.title: Prepare sequencing library mix
steps.instruction: To the recovered 8 µL library, add 7 µL RNase‑free water and 15 µL Nanopore Sequencing Buffer (RRB), mix gently by pipetting.

steps.title: Prepare flush buffer mix
steps.instruction: In a new 1.5 mL Lo‑Bind Safe‑Lock tube, combine 117 µL Flush Buffer (FLB) with 3 µL Flush Tether (FLT).

steps.title: Prime Flongle flow cell
steps.instruction: Prime the Flongle flow cell with 120 µL of the Flush Buffer mix, dispensing slowly (use the pipette adjustment wheel) to avoid force and air bubbles.

steps.title: Load library onto flow cell
steps.instruction: Immediately after priming, add 30 µL of the prepared library mix to the Flongle flow cell, dispensing gently with the pipette adjustment wheel.

steps.title: Start sequencing run
steps.instruction: Launch MinKNOW (version ≥ 19.12.5), select Flongle as the flow cell and RNA‑002 kit, and begin sequencing.

steps.title: Perform flow‑cell QC
steps.instruction: Insert the Flongle adapter and flow cell into the MinION, run the 'Test Flow Cell' program in MinKNOW to assess flow‑cell quality.
